final_rationale: The verdict does not change. The Actor provided no new admissible evidence and explicitly listed no new evidence IDs. The response is a narrower interpretation of the same record: aggregate readiness and rehearsal stability support part of the certification case, while the material segment weakness would need to be handled through explicit disclosure in current-release documentation. That narrowing is analytically better than a clean-compliance claim, but it is still conditional. Under the policy text, certification may proceed only if the current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and material segment weaknesses are disclosed or covered by an approved mitigation. The available record still does not show that the required disclosure is already present in the current certification artifact, and the Actor concedes there is no approved mitigation or reviewed risk acceptance. Because the unresolved issue is an actual policy predicate, not merely an overbroad framing problem, the case remains suspicious rather than compliant_with_caveats. A caveated position could become compliant_with_caveats if the current release artifact itself were provided and showed the required disclosure, but that evidence is not in this record.
